title: AgentRQ 作为 ZAgenticOPN Experience Version C-route 候选的定向技术研究
summary: AgentRQ 是一个与当前问题高度相关的 Human-Agent task/workspace 平台：它有 MCP getTask 队列、任务状态与消息、事件/通知和 Codex/ACP gateway。固定 commit 的代码深读同时显示，get-next-task 与 ongoing 状态更新是分开的，任务模型没有 ZAgenticOPN 所需的 AgentInstance/Claim 记录，另一 Agent reviewer continuation 也没有被证明。因此结论是：不重跑全部旧候选；保留 AgentRQ 作为新的 C-route selective-reuse 候选，只对 MCP/gateway/notification 单位能力做受控 C1/C2/C4 验证，ZAgenticOPN 继续拥有产品语义和原子 Claim。

concepts.value: 当前为 Experience Version；研究范围必须服务同设备 Codex → WorkBuddy → Codex 单项目纵向切片，不把生产部署、自动发现、恢复和完整工作流平台提前纳入。
当前问题不是寻找一个全平台替代，而是判断新候选是否能缩短已观察到的 activation/claim 路由失败，并且不转移 ZAgenticOPN 的产品语义所有权。
按 R5/R6/R8 硬门、单位能力组合、语义适配、证据强度和 Experience Version 工作量判断；Stars=1,088、topicMatch=20 仅是 sealed ledger 背景事实，不是能力分数。
ZAgenticOPN 保有 Work Item eligibility、原子 Claim、结果/review 状态、scope、private context 和 Git provenance；AgentRQ 只能通过明确 adapter 或单位能力边界进入。
sealed ledger 的 canonical evidence 主要是仓库维护/入口文档；更深的任务 dequeue、状态写入、session mapping 和插件生命周期事实来自同一 pinned commit 的 Repository Map 与 Architecture Study，尚未被独立黑盒 conformance 证明。

cards.title: agentrq/agentrq（new C-route candidate）
cards.summary: Pinned commit 45c8739 exposes a Go/Fiber/GORM workspace task platform, MCP tools and published harness/gateway seams. The source map and depth studies identify a real queue and message surface, but also show that atomic claim and reviewer-Agent continuation remain unverified; it is a selective-reuse candidate, not a replacement base.

claims.text: The sealed source notes establish a Go backend with Fiber/GORM/MCP surfaces and a plugin layout, while the pinned Repository Map records backend, frontend, integration and harness package boundaries.

AgentRQ's pinned maintenance/source notes identify a workspace task server and server-side task handling; the pinned Architecture Study resolves the concrete get-next-task path to a query over notstarted agent-assigned tasks. This is a queue/discovery signal, not proof of an atomic Claim.

The pinned repository exposes harness plugins and MCP-oriented integration surfaces, making it a plausible adapter candidate for the current activation-routing failure; gateway compatibility and lifecycle responsibilities still require a bounded experiment.

The sealed deployment evidence requires JWT/workspace token configuration and exposes persistent runtime responsibilities; the repository license is Apache-2.0 in the pinned source, but credential and dangerous-operation boundaries remain integration-owned decisions.

The current evidence does not prove R6 atomic competing claim or R8 reviewer-Agent continuation. The code study records an explicit unknown/risk boundary rather than converting missing black-box evidence into absent capability.

The target product must keep its Work Item eligibility, Claim, result/review, scope, private context and Git provenance semantics. AgentRQ can only supply a removable transport or unit capability behind that owner boundary.

comparisons.text: Constraint: the Human-triggered slice needs task-agnostic frontier discovery. Option: AgentRQ MCP getTask/dequeue. Evidence: sealed source notes identify the workspace task server and code study resolves a notstarted+agent queue query. Tradeoff: promising native queue unit, but its poller/push behavior crosses the no-automatic-discovery boundary. Decision: test only an explicit activation adapter and retain eligibility ownership in ZAgenticOPN.

Constraint: one Work Item must have one effective claimant under concurrency. Option: reuse AgentRQ queue/status pair. Evidence: source study shows selection and status update as separate operations, while the sealed evidence only points to the server surface. Tradeoff: the candidate may need a wrapper-owned Claim record or transaction. Decision: R6 remains unknown; no claim ownership transfer.

Constraint: another Agent must continue review without Human context copying. Option: use AgentRQ reply, conversation, event and gateway transport. Evidence: the candidate has message/event/plugin surfaces, but no sealed or black-box proof of reviewer-Agent state semantics. Tradeoff: transport is useful, semantic adaptation is substantial. Decision: treat as adapted transport and require C4 fixture.

Constraint: current stage permits only work that serves the vertical slice or observed failure. Option: rerun every old candidate versus targeted AgentRQ study. Evidence: existing research receipts are healthy and the active roadmap failure is activation/claim routing; AgentRQ has a direct integration signal. Tradeoff: broad rerun spends effort without changing the current decision, targeted study addresses the blocker. Decision: do not rerun all old projects now; keep that work deferred until a concrete capability gap reopens the gate.

Constraint: Experience Version must avoid importing deferred production/workflow responsibilities. Option: whole AgentRQ platform, thin adapter, or selective MCP/gateway units. Evidence: deployment/auth/task/workflow surfaces are broad and candidate claim/review semantics are not proven. Tradeoff: whole adoption creates state, credential, upgrade and lifecycle ownership; selective reuse limits the seam. Decision: choose C-route selective reuse pending validation.

recommendations.text: Do not rerun all projects currently under research/ as a blanket refresh. The open-source gate has healthy existing receipts, C-route ownership is already authorized, and the active blocker is the Agent integration/activation path. Reopen the broad comparison only when a concrete current-slice capability gap or candidate change invalidates the existing decision.

Retain AgentRQ as a new selective-reuse candidate. Prioritize its MCP workspace transport, notifications and Codex/ACP gateway seams as adapted units; do not adopt its whole product, poller, scheduler, workflow, supervisor or deployment surface in the current Experience Version.

Treat R6 as unknown/unverified until a fixed concurrent fixture proves exactly one effective claimant and zero duplicate execution. If AgentRQ cannot prove this, place the Claim transaction/record in ZAgenticOPN-owned code and use AgentRQ only as transport.

Treat R8 as unknown/unverified until a second Agent can discover structured result/next action, claim review, validate and complete without Human context supplementation. Agent-to-Human reply and event fan-out alone do not pass the reviewer-Agent gate.

Next validation: same-device single-project adapter fixture with task-agnostic activation, one get-next operation, competing consumers, structured result/review, and Git provenance. Record R5/R6/R8 plus Human intervention; stop or keep AgentRQ deferred if any core gate remains unverified.

The sealed ledger's seven canonical records are discovery evidence, not a runtime conformance proof. Keep the Repository Map/Architecture Study bundles bound to commit 45c8739, and make all remaining source/test/black-box gaps explicit before any B/C implementation decision.

metrics.definition: 存在 eligible work 时，任务无关激活能让 Agent 发现正确 Work Item 的比例
metrics.method: 固定同设备 fixture 连续 3 次，核对 get-next、eligibility、Human 是否提供 task ID
metrics.condition: 仅给初始目标和检查 shared context

metrics.definition: 并发消费者中仅一个成为有效 claimant 且仅一次执行的比例
metrics.method: 同时启动两个消费者，检查持久化 Claim、状态事件、执行和 Git provenance
metrics.condition: 同一 Work Item，连续至少 3 轮

metrics.definition: reviewer Agent 无 Human 上下文补充完成发现、claim、验证和发布的比例
metrics.method: 用结构化 result_summary、next_action、acceptance_status、references fixture 进行独立 reviewer 激活
metrics.condition: awaiting-review/next-work 场景，连续至少 3 轮

metrics.definition: MCP/gateway 断连后任务通知和会话接续可复核的比例
metrics.method: 记录连接、断连、重连、重复推送去重和任务 session 关联事件
metrics.condition: 仅在接入适配实验需要时测量，不作为当前产品 SLO
metrics.expected: 实验内无丢失或重复执行

metrics.definition: 由 ZAgenticOPN 明确拥有的核心语义项数量
metrics.method: 按 eligibility、Claim、result、review、scope、private context、Git provenance 建立 ownership matrix
metrics.condition: 任何 AgentRQ adapter 设计评审
